Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 29 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Sonali - 58 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sunita - 29 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Vinod stands in the ward. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Vinod, what's the plan today?"

[Vinod weeps beside the body.]

Vinod: "Oh wow!"

[Vinod lies down on the hospital bed.]

Vinod: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vinod stands in the living room. Sonali and Sunita stand near him.]

Sonali: "Vinod, look over here."

[The doorbell rings; Vinod opens the door and takes the parcel.]

Vinod: "Mom, listen!"

[Vinod orders food on his phone.]

Vinod: "That was such a fun day!"
